title: Sources coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-line-pullback]. For a Cartesian square with smooth vertical map, define the source comparison $Lg'^*J_f\simeq J_{f'}Lg^*$ by the inverse-image tensorator, canonical pullback-square isomorphism, and normalized derived line pullback. For composable smooth maps of dimensions $d,e$, define $J_{gf,d+e}\simeq J_{f,d}J_{g,e}$ by pullback composition, the inverse derived line product, symmetry, associativity, line pullback and the tensorator. The composite compactification is the literal open/open and proper/proper factorization through a boundary compactification of the intervening proper/open composite.
